description: List task lists (id, name, project_id, milestone_id), e.g. to pick a tasklist_id when creating a task. Paymo: GET /api/tasklists.

include.description: Related objects to embed (Paymo `include`), comma-separated, e.g. client or tasklists.tasks.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 100, max 500). Paymo has no pagination; results beyond this are truncated.

project_id.description: Only task lists from this project.

name: paymo_list_tasklists
title: List task lists
